description: Get the current US equity market status (NYSE/Nasdaq), evaluated in America/New_York: whether the market is open, the current session (pre-market, regular, after-hours, or closed), whether today is a full-day holiday or a 1:00 p.m. ET early close, today's regular and extended (pre-market/after-hours) trading hours, and the next open and next close. Backed by the exchange's curated holiday and early-close calendar, not a heuristic.
name: GetMarketStatus
title: US Market Status
